title: Grilled Sea Bass Skewers
description: A simple and flavorful Brazilian-inspired dish featuring marinated sea bass grilled to perfection on skewers.

ingredients.name: skewers
ingredients.amount: 10-12 wooden skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes

instructions:
Preheat grill to medium-high heat (400°F).
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, and chili powder.
Add sea bass fillets to the marinade and mix to coat.
Thread 2-3 pieces of sea bass onto each skewer.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve hot with lemon wedges on the side.
